meta.title: Archive robustness checks
meta.coverage: Polymarket and Kalshi only; other venues are excluded because the shipped row-level panels needed for these checks are unavailable. Pooled results here do not mean all six dashboard venues.
meta.clockNote: Horizon = days before the source-reported anchor, not independently verified actual event occurrence. Polymarket uses the earlier archived scheduled expiry/close; Kalshi uses recorded trading close, which can follow the public result. Quote age is cutoff minus selected completed bar/trade timestamp; all observations are within the preceding 24 hours.
meta.intervalNote: Approximate 95% Student-t intervals, clustering by archive-defined venue-event. Contract weights use a cluster-robust ratio-mean variance; event weights average contracts within each venue-event and give those events equal weight. Intervals are suppressed below 20 events or at zero estimated variance. They do not account for related events, overlapping real-world events across venues, source omissions, or timing errors.
meta.biasNote: Signed gap = observed win rate minus mean probability. Positive means favorites won more often than priced. Opposing errors can cancel: a small signed gap is not proof of full calibration. Brier score evaluates every original probability; lower is better.
meta.heldOutNote: A single fixed chronological split, 1 January 2025. Training includes only venue-events whose latest source anchor is before 1 December 2024; test quotes occur on/after 1 January 2025. No venue-event appears in both. One logit intercept is fitted separately for each displayed venue/category/horizon, with equal event weights, and then held fixed. The favored side is selected using the original quote and remains fixed after correction. Settlement publication times are unavailable, so this is retrospective out-of-time evidence, not a claim that training labels were available then or a tradable strategy. Test intervals condition on the fitted correction; inspecting many slices is exploratory.
meta.calendarNote: Calendar comparison uses quote dates in complete years 2024 and 2025. Retain only venue×broad-category strata with at least 20 venue-events in each year. Give each common stratum equal weight, and each venue-event equal weight within a stratum. This holds those mix weights constant but cannot hold event difficulty or within-category composition constant. Intervals condition on strata and weights, cluster by venue-event across strata, and preserve overlapping event clusters between years when estimating changes. The t critical value uses the smallest retained stratum event count.
meta.scopeNote: Original favorites must be at least 51%. Every eligible contract/horizon occurs once. Pooled event IDs are namespaced by venue; the same real-world event listed on two venues remains two clusters. No probability bins are used in these checks.
